item.description:
## Cursor prompts are now visible
- Reads user-authored prompts from Cursor's first-party local agent transcripts after Prompt Intelligence is enabled. - Links Cursor prompt chains to the exact local Cursor composer session. - Keeps transcript-only Cursor conversations navigable when Cursor omits their composer header. - Shows Cursor as the calling harness and preserves the local workspace label. - Excludes assistant messages, subagent transcripts, and browser data. - Keeps the same local redaction, encryption, retention, and deletion controls used by other supported prompt sources.

## Prompt Intelligence you can trust
- Excludes Codex-injected plugin, environment, permission, skill, app, AGENTS, interruption, and image context from user prompts. - Excludes OpenCode synthetic tool-call echoes from user prompts. - Links every prompt chain to its exact provider usage session, and every session back to its prompt chain. - Shows the calling harness or app, billing route, model, effort, tokens, and estimated API value alongside each prompt when available. - Corrects turn-level token attribution for prompt chains with more than one prompt. - Refreshes the AgentsEye website with Prompt Intelligence, harness attribution, session linking, current downloads, and corrected product copy.

AgentsEye 0.17.18 adds automatic recovery for Prompt Intelligence refresh failures.
- If a prompt refresh is interrupted by a crash, the next launch automatically turns prompt capture off instead of repeating the crash loop. - When prompt capture is off, AgentsEye no longer opens the encrypted prompt vault or requests Keychain access. - Prompt capture can be enabled again from the Prompts page after the app recovers. - The support page now includes recovery instructions for users trapped on 0.17.15.
